protocol.name: BL21(DE3) Chemical Transformation with pET28a
protocol.purpose: Introduce a plasmid into BL21(DE3) competent E. coli cells for protein expression.
materials: LB agar plate with appropriate antibiotic
42 C heat block or water bath

steps.text: Thaw 1 tube of BL21(DE3) competent cells on ice.
Add 200ng of {{ph:1774125436234-cac9aa958fe75}} DNA to the cells and gently flick to mix.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 30 min.
Heat shock the cells at 42 C for 45 s, then immediately place them back on ice for 1 min.
Add 1 mL of SOC medium and recover the cells at 37 C with shaking for 1 h.
Plate 100 uL of the recovery culture onto an LB agar plate containing Kanamycin.
Incubate the plate at 37 C for overnight until colonies appear.

protocol.troubleshooting:
Problem: No colonies on plate; Possible cause: Competent cells lost efficiency or antibiotic selection was incorrect; Solution: Use fresh competent cells and verify the plasmid resistance marker matches the plate antibiotic
Problem: Too many background colonies; Possible cause: Contamination or insufficient antibiotic concentration; Solution: Prepare fresh selective plates and use sterile technique throughout
